title: What if you fell into a volcano? (you don't sink)
hook: WHAT IF you fell into a volcano?
altHooks: Lava: 1,100 °C. You: on top of it.
caption: You wouldn't sink. Lava is ~1,100 °C, three times denser than you and a hundred thousand times thicker than water — so you'd lie on top of it and burn. Sources: Oregon State Volcano World, USGS (1961), Sciencing, SFU Earth Sciences.

render.gl: swangle (no GPU box); use angle on a desktop GPU

qa.selfReview: Stills read 3x at phone scale. postingNotes: Trial-reel variant plan: render 3 versions with altHooks (same body), post to non-followers, keep the hook with the best 3-second retention. Verify the facts' secondary sources against a current USGS page before the final render.
